headline: GARCIA ASKS ERIC TRUMP
dek: The top Democrat on House Oversight listed Eric Trump’s business ties on X. Eric Trump calls Garcia’s TV remarks “untrue and libelous.”

graphic.title: THE TIES GARCIA LISTED · WHAT THE RECORD SHOWS

rows.text: Joined its board of advisors in Feb. 2025, the company said. Dominari says advisers have no voting rights or legal authority.
Named to the Japanese bitcoin firm’s strategic board of advisors in March 2025.
A 6% stake held by his LLC, for advice and introductions through his “network of contacts,” SEC filings show. The firm does drone-defense work.
Invested in the Israeli drone maker’s deal to go public, announced Feb. 2026, Reuters reported.
Garcia cites a $24 million Pentagon contract. CNBC reports Foundation didn’t win it directly; it came with a robotics firm Foundation bought in 2024.

graphic.left: “If you want to fully explain to the American people how this isn’t some big misunderstanding, come testify under oath voluntarily. January is right around the corner.”
graphic.right: Garcia’s TV statement was “untrue and libelous.” He sits on “ZERO” boards of directors, has “NEVER” worked on procuring a government contract, and his advisory groups have “ZERO decision-making power.”

means.label: A request, not a subpoena:
means.text: Garcia asked on X for voluntary testimony. He is expected to chair Oversight when Democrats take the House in January.

means.label: Different rules:
means.text: A president’s relatives with no government job aren’t covered by federal ethics and disclosure rules for officials.

means.label: Related, separate:
means.text: Rep. Jamie Raskin is probing Donald Trump Jr.’s venture firm, 1789 Capital.

sources: Sources: @RepRobertGarcia posts, Nov. 22–23; @EricTrump posts, Nov. 23–24; Newsweek, Nov. 24; WSJ, Aug. 27; CNBC, Nov. 14; Reuters, Feb. 17; Dominari release, Feb. 11, 2025; Metaplanet via Reuters, Mar. 21, 2025; Space-Eyes SEC filing; AP.
